intent: The Assets left-rail panel — a per-project media library to browse, filter, search, and insert uploaded images, video, and audio.
guidance: Presentational and fully controlled: it emits callbacks (onUpload, onDropFiles, onInsert, onAddToTimeline, onRename, onDelete, onRetry) and runs no upload or drag-drop side effects — the host owns bytes, undo, and persistence. Card click is panel-local highlight only; insertion is what enters editor selection. Insert routes video and audio to onAddToTimeline and images to onInsert. Delete confirms only when inUseCount > 0. Control width from the host so it survives switching left-rail tabs (Composa#664). Video cards skim on pointer move — only the hovered card mounts a decoder, and the static poster stays the keyboard/touch fallback. Audio cards draw a waveform instead of a colour tint. Pass libraries to group cards under labelled sections.

anatomy.description: 40px row: the title label (default "Assets") plus the Upload icon button; bottom border.
A single SingleTab label ("Library") — one view remains, so it is a label, not a tablist.
Search field (name filter) above a borderless type-filter Dropdown (All · Images · Videos · Audio); bordered top and bottom.
Scrollable 2-column thumbnail grid; when libraries are passed, cards split into aria-labelled <section> groups with a header + optional open-chevron, ungrouped cards trailing.
Thumbnail (image/video poster, tint fallback, or audio waveform) with a type badge (IMG/VID/AUD), a duration badge for video/audio, and hover Insert + Delete quick-actions; truncated filename below.
Shown when no assets exist: an image icon, "No assets yet", and an Upload media button.
Full-panel dashed drop target ("Drop to upload") that appears while OS files are dragged over the panel.
Right-click context menu (Insert/Add to timeline, Rename, Delete) plus Rename and in-use Delete-confirm modals.

use_when: Showing a project's uploaded media in the left rail so it can be inserted onto the slide or timeline.
You need per-card upload progress, error/retry, and OS drag-drop onto the panel.
Grouping media under named libraries via `libraries` + `AssetItem.libraryId`.
dont_use_when: Editing the selected element's properties — use Inspector / PropertyPanel.
Picking a document colour or variable — use ColorDialog.
You need a global or shared asset browser — this stores per-project media only.

type.note: Header title, badges, Retry, and the empty upload button use hardcoded sizes/weights (title 13px/550 leading-[22px] tracking-[-0.0325px]; badges text-[9px] font-[550]; search 11px/16px), and badge/card box metrics are raw px.

tokens.note: The DEMO_ASSETS default data hardcodes #hex tint gradients (e.g. #7c5cff, #ff6ac1); the scrub playhead uses bg-white/90 + shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.6) and the hover overlay uses from-black/25. Because #hex literals exist, tokensOnly is not asserted.

a11y.role: No landmark role on the panel container (a plain resizable div shell from SidePanel); grouped libraries render as aria-labelled <section> regions.
a11y.cards: Each card is a button with aria-label (filename) and aria-pressed (selection); video cards add aria-describedby to an sr-only skim instruction.
a11y.controls: The filter Dropdown has ariaLabel "Filter by type"; Upload / Insert / Delete / Open-library buttons carry aria-label + title; the search input uses a placeholder.
a11y.video-preview: The preview <video> and playhead are aria-hidden; the static poster stays available for keyboard and touch input.
a11y.resize: SidePanel exposes the right-edge handle as role="separator" with aria-orientation/valuenow/valuemin/valuemax.

code.example:
<AssetsPanel
  assets={assets}
  selectedId={selectedId}
  onSelect={(id) => setSelectedId(id)}
  onUpload={openFilePicker}
  onDropFiles={upload}
  onInsert={insertOnSlide}
  onAddToTimeline={addClip}
  onDelete={removeAsset}
/>
